name: null-zoo
description: Size and power of backtest-overfitting and data-snooping tests on synthetic searches with known ground truth.
author: Arhan Canli

scripts.reproduce:v0: node src/scripts/research/null-zoo/run.mjs 2000 > /tmp/null-zoo-v0.json && cmp /tmp/null-zoo-v0.json src/config/research/null-zoo-v0.json && echo 'v0 reproduces byte for byte'
scripts.v2: python analysis/v2/run_v2.py > analysis/v2/results-v2.json 2> analysis/v2/run-v2.log && python analysis/v2/arch_check.py > analysis/v2/arch-check-v2.json 2> analysis/v2/arch-check-v2.log && python analysis/v2/evaluate_v2.py
scripts.reproduce:v1: node src/scripts/research/null-zoo/v1/run.mjs 10000 > /tmp/null-zoo-v1.json && cmp /tmp/null-zoo-v1.json src/config/research/null-zoo-v1.json && echo 'v1 reproduces byte for byte'
scripts.reproduce:v1b: node src/scripts/research/null-zoo/v1/run.mjs 10000 $(nproc 2>/dev/null || sysctl -n hw.ncpu) 20261005 > /tmp/null-zoo-v1b.json && cmp /tmp/null-zoo-v1b.json src/config/research/null-zoo-v1b.json && echo 'v1b reproduces byte for byte'
